DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa) is a research data metadata index of DataCite (deposit metadata from Zenodo, Mendeley Data, figshare, Harvard Dataverse, the Copernicus Emergency Management Service and other repositories). Coverage: Africa. 326 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 283 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
